items.title: misaligned-half-score
items.claim: In Image #8, the fraction in both the HUD’s 2½ and the result’s 0 — 2½ hangs below the neighboring whole numbers.
items.reason: The score reads as separate vertically scattered digits.
items.suggest: Keep the integer and fraction in one inline row, with the fraction vertically centered beside the integer.

items.title: unreadable-kick-foot
items.claim: In Image #13, Asmongold’s raised leg ends abruptly near the trouser cuff, and I cannot distinguish a complete foot despite the FRONT KICK label.
items.reason: The incomplete silhouette makes the technique harder to recognize.
items.suggest: Inspect that atlas cell and give the raised foot a complete, clearly visible silhouette.

items.title: wrong-way-result-pose
items.claim: In Image #18, the winning Asmongold extends his kicking foot left while HasanAbi stands to his right.
items.reason: The result illustration shows the strike pointing away from the opponent.
items.suggest: Use a dedicated victory stance for the result screen.

items.title: tiny-technique-metadata
items.claim: In Image #6, the technique metadata letters are roughly 10px tall when the screenshot is scaled to the stated 390px viewport.
items.reason: Players must read these labels to compare target height and scoring value.
items.suggest: Set metadata to at least 18 CSS px and wrap it beneath each move name.

items.title: unexplained-result-time
items.claim: Image #18 shows a 29s bout clock alongside BEST 6.4S without identifying what time the record measures.
items.reason: A player cannot reconcile the remaining bout time with the displayed record.
items.suggest: Show explicitly labeled elapsed time on the result and define BEST using that same clock.
